fact: Thorin made a successful check revealing that the stone giant had gone mad.
source_quote: Thorin drew on his deep familiarity with giant-kind and made a successful check (a 16) that revealed the terrible truth: this creature had not chosen violence but had gone mad.
subject: Thorin

fact: Stone giants are unforgiving toward those who kill their kind but forgiving of those who spare them.
source_quote: Stone giants are particularly unforgiving toward those who kill their kind, and particularly forgiving of those who spare them.
subject: Stone Giants

source_quote: Thorin urged the party and the duergar militia alike to bring the giant down without killing him.

fact: The party switched to non-lethal weapon attacks.
source_quote: The party switched to non-lethal weapon attacks
subject: Party switches tactics

fact: The duergar militia ignored Thorin's plea and delivered the killing blow to the giant.
source_quote: The militia, bound by their rigid code and unable to tell friend from foe inside Zalthir's magical darkness that blanketed part of the street, delivered the killing blow.

fact: Rihuud is dead, killed by the duergar militia.

subject: Thorin
